Its theme is the need to protect family and country.  The movie grossed 79 million baht.

The soundtrack was scored by regular Anderson collaborator Mark Mothersbaugh and features several songs by bands associated with the British Invasion of the 1960s.

It debuted at the Rome Film Festival and was released online on November 13, 2013.  It quickly became viral and received critical acclaim.
